# Budget Car Rental

> > Budget Car Rental offers affordable vehicle rentals across the United States, Canada, and Australia with services including Fastbreak, RapidRez, and the Budget Business Program.

Budget provides a comprehensive fleet of cars, SUVs, vans, and trucks with rental protection options, child safety equipment, and flexible payment plans. The site serves customers globally with multilingual support and location-specific information.

## Key Topics

- Budget Car Rental
- Fastbreak
- RapidRez
- Loss Damage Waiver (LDW)
- Supplemental Liability Insurance (SLI)
- Budget Business Program
- Vehicle rental fleet
- Rental insurance and protections
- Child safety seats
- Roadside assistance
- International locations (US, Canada, Australia)
- Reservation requirements
- SUV and truck rentals
- Payment options (Uplift financing)
- Customer support and contact information

## Rental Requirements & Support

- [What Do You Need to Rent a Car](https://www.budget.com/en/help/usa-faqs/required-credentials): Rental requirements: driver's license, ID, debit card & age restrictions
- [Worldwide Phone Numbers](https://www.budget.com/en/customer-care/worldwide-telephone-numbers): Global contact numbers for Budget reservations, roadside assistance & support
- [Reservation Feedback Form](https://www.budget.com/en/customer-care/comments-and-feedback/budget-car-reservation-question): Submit questions and feedback about Budget car rental reservations
- [Rules for Vaping & Smoking in a Rental Car](https://www.budget.com/en/help/usa-faqs/smoking-policy): No-smoking policy for Budget's smoke-free rental fleet and cleaning fees

## Rental Protection & Insurance

- [Loss Damage Waiver Protection](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services/protections/loss-damage-waiver): LDW protection coverage for rental car damage or theft from $9/day
- [Supplemental Liability Insurance](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services/protections/supplemental-liability-insurance): SLI coverage for third-party injury and property damage claims at $15/day

## Vehicle Fleet & Rental Options

- [Budget USA Rental Car Guides: All Available Vehicles](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/vehicles/us): Complete USA vehicle fleet guide: cars, SUVs, vans, trucks with specs
- [GMC Yukon Rental & Similar SUVs](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/gmc/yukon): GMC Yukon and similar full-size premium SUV rental options with features
- [Toyota Tacoma Rental & Similar Trucks](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/toyota/tacoma): Toyota Tacoma and similar midsize pickup truck rentals for hauling

## Products & Services

- [Child Safety Seats with your Car Rental](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services/products/child-safety-seats): Child safety seat rental options including infant seats and boosters
- [Uplift](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services/services/uplift): Pay for Budget car rentals over time with Uplift installment financing

## Locations

- [Rent a car in 4 locations across Northern Territory, AU](https://www.budget.com/en/locations/au/nt): Budget car rental locations in Northern Territory: Darwin, Alice Springs

## Optional

- [Trip Guides and Inspiration](https://www.budget.com/en/travel): Road trip guides & travel inspiration for USA destinations like Pacific Coast
